A man hires a killer to bump off his wife, but instead, he kills another woman with the exact same name.
A young German grifter moves to America, adopts various identities and kills many people along the way.
A young teen disappears from a small American town. Then several years later, he turns up, in Europe. But is it really him? And if not, what happened to the young teen?
A man is murdered by his cheating wife's lover, who had been living in their closet.
A dead body discovered outside of a church leads to a world of sex, drugs, and Halloween pranks.
A Washington man hires a sleazy amateur hitman to kill his wife. And when she turns the tables on her attacker, the gaping holes in their master plan are revealed.

A murdered Nebraska woman is connected to three men with hidden agendas—her best friend, her neighbor, and her ex-boyfriend. And a high-tech whodunit investigation ultimately reveals the killer left behind a smoking 'bun'.

After a whirlwind romance, a 40-something San Francisco woman finds herself married to the man of her dreams. Only she soon finds herself hospitalized with a mysterious illness, and her fairytale becomes a bizarre murder mystery instead.

An aspiring cannibal finds an online buddy who fantasizes about being eaten. And when the two men arrange a dinner where the guest of honor is also the main course, the macabre soiree turns into a horrifying bloodbath.

A woman is bludgeoned to death in her own home, and her severely handicapped teenage daughter goes missing. When investigators eventually catch up with the young woman, they hear a baffling story of a mother's toxic love.

Celebrity little people and twin wrestlers Jorge and Miguel have a larger-than-life appetite for drugs and alcohol. And when they're both found dead after a wild night of partying, an autopsy reveals the culprit is eye drops.
A high-rolling, high-priced fortune-teller is slaughtered, and detectives must decipher a bizarre set of clues that weave superstition and brutality in equal measure.
A wannabe serial killer ropes in his first unsuspecting victim. But it turns out that killing in real life is trickier than it looks on TV.

When a man's fiancée is brutally stabbed to death, he finds solace in the arms of a sympathetic ex-lover. But when she is later arrested for attempting to murder her own husband, a shocking web of love, obsession, and deceit begins to unravel.
Faced with mounting debts and his upcoming honeymoon, a delusional bloodthirsty actor casts himself in a role that includes murder and dismemberment.
An anti-drug crusader's home is torched. But when a body is discovered in the freezer, the curious case of arson becomes a twisted tale of fratricide.
When a couple disappears from a Georgia beach town, detectives interrogate a pair of gun-toting cat burglars with dueling cover stories, some sordid souvenirs, and a telltale scrapbook.

When a Michigan woman is shot to death, investigators write it off as a hunting accident. But the case heats up when police discover that the woman's husband had taken out a huge amount of life insurance on her before her death.
A look at the controversial case of North Carolina author Michael Peterson, convicted of murdering his wife, a high powered business executive.

After 17 years in prison, Marty Tankleff is finally free and his almost-two-decade tragic journey has ended and become national news. 19 years ago, 17-year-old Marty was accused of murdering his parents.
American Justice looks at some of the most notorious cases of police killings in recent times.

In the Depression-torn dust bowl of the 1930s, a new kind of desperado is born. Pretty Boy Floyd, John Dillinger, and Bonnie & Clyde become as well-known and admired as movie stars. Bill Kurtis narrates their murderous rise and deadly fall

The Prohibition Act of 1919 turns the petty vice and extortion gangs into criminal armies and helps sow the seeds of what will become the great crime syndicates. Brooklyn D.A. Charles Hynes is interviewed.

The story of the tragic assault on the Branch Davidian compound in Texas and the subsequent efforts to determine the facts and assign blame. Shows how federal authorities misread cult leader David Koresh.
A missionary working in Haiti is ambushed, shot and held for ransom by a gang. A tunneler returns to an underground shaft minutes after escaping to rescue two colleagues from the flooded cavity.
Attacked in her home by her mother's boyfriend, a 17-year-old girl fights to stay alive after having her throat cut.
The brothers examine the evolution of Birmingham's gang culture, exploring its brutal criminal networks and violent attacks.
The brothers explore Sheffield's brutal gang history, including the bloody vendetta between the fiercely territorial S3 and S4 gangs.
The brothers visit Manchester to investigate a Victorian gang called the Scuttlers. They also look at the Gooches, who were active until only a few years ago.
The brothers exploring a gang's botched 1990 raid on a security van in Surrey, as well as the exploits of Alice Diamond's Forty Elephants.
The brothers delve into the British capital's vicious underbelly and the ruthless crime rackets of gangs past and present, exploring a city with a lengthy history of skulduggery.
The brothers explore the gang history of Liverpool and reveal the story of a 1990's drug lord who became one of the country's wealthiest men.
Brothers Gary and Martin Kemp delve into the violent history of gangland Britain and explore the country's most notorious crime families.
The brothers reveal who once ran and who now runs gangland Britain, asking if they still make money and maintain power in the same way.
After finding the body of a young girl in a stream located in the suburbs of Montreal, investigators strive to retrace a murderer who knew how to use water to his advantage.
